## Summary

Describe the user-visible or contract-level change.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests were written before implementation.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run audit:public` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:demo` passes when GUI behavior changes.
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese documentation are both updated when required.
- [ ] Compiler and runner code import no AI provider and receive no AI credentials.

## Evidence

List commands and concise results. Do not attach secrets, customer data, or private PRDs.
